summary: Recaps and blurbs work again on RoyalRoad's beta layout.
fixes: Recaps on the beta layout no longer fail with "Could not find the previous chapter's title" — RoyalRoad rearranged its chapter header and RoyalRefresh was still looking for the old one
The blurb on the beta layout showed the author's profile text instead of the story's description
On the beta layout, a custom selector for where the Show Recap button goes is now actually used
